name: Igor Szuniewicz
summary: I build audio that reacts to the player: spatial sound in VR, real-time ML tools and C++/JUCE plug-ins. Classically trained pianist.

experience.title: Freelance Sound Designer - Games
experience.text: Independent sound design and audio implementation for game projects.

experience.title: Technical Sound Designer - XR Labs
experience.text: Built audio for police, military and customs VR training in Unity. Tuned Steam Audio spatialisation in-headset so trainees could locate gunshots and hear obstruction. Built the weapon audio system and designed Taser T10 sounds from layered library recordings.

experience.title: AI Audio Research - Bachelor thesis
experience.text: Measured the delay from an in-game event to generated audio playback using an Unreal client, Python generation server, cache and synthesis fallback. Documented the results in a 68-page thesis.
